steps.note: Create the RFQ event used by the bid-rule test.
Configure the event as an RFQ rather than the default auction.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Add one line item for the vendor quote.
Set and commit a live bidding window.
Invite the vendor company whose two users are being tested.
Publish the live RFQ before opening it from the vendor portal.
Confirm the RFQ reached a real published project page.
Submit the first user's bid of 100 from the vendor portal.
Confirm the first bid was accepted by the vendor portal.

args.need: sign in as the second user of Vendor A in a separate vendor-portal session, open this live RFQ, submit a bid of 98, and report whether it is refused with the same-team bid message or becomes a revision
